description: Read-only fetch of one exact section or record by dotted path. Sections: organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, research, externalAssets, pages, answers, caseStudies, blogs. Use this when you know the path from search/list; use nebula_get_overview instead for a summary, nebula_search_knowledge instead to find paths, nebula_list_knowledge instead to browse titles. Returns path plus value, or for list sections: items, total, offset, limit, nextOffset. Reading one Answer ("answers.4") adds fullAnswer, its full body in Markdown; "caseStudies.0" returns one full case study. For full blog article bodies use nebula_get_blog (blogs here stay compact: title, url, excerpt, date). Examples: "services", "answers.4", "caseStudies.0", "organization.address".

limit.description: For list sections: items per page (default 20)

offset.description: For list sections: first item index (default 0)

name: nebula_get_section
title: Get Nebula section
